SCENE 1. A rain-soaked street at night.
Rain falls. LIN stands under an awning, watching a doorway. ASH steps out of the shadows.
LIN: You're late. Did anyone follow you?
ASH: No. The rain covers everything.
LIN: Then talk. What did you find in the office?
ASH: The files were moved. Someone cleaned the room before dawn.

SCENE 2. A dry office interior, later that night.
The room is empty. LIN opens a drawer; ASH keeps watch at the door.
LIN: The drawer is empty. They took everything.
ASH: Except this envelope. It has your name on it.
LIN: Then we are already too late.
